headline: UK sanctions eight Israeli firms building West Bank settlements and a group blocking Gaza aid
summary: Britain imposed sanctions on Tuesday 17 November on eight Israeli construction and property companies that build settlements in the occupied West Bank. It also targeted Tzav 9, a group it accuses of blocking aid trucks to Gaza.
why: It is Britain’s first concrete step since it said in September it would respond to faster settlement growth. The UK says it wants to keep a future Palestinian state possible. Relations between the UK and Israel have grown tense over the war in Gaza and settlement building.

event.t: The eight companies face asset freezes, and their directors can be banned from running companies in the UK.
Sanctions were also placed on Tzav 9, an activist group the UK says regularly blocks aid trucks carrying food, water and fuel into Gaza.
The UK Foreign Office says it is the first sanctions package since its September change of approach to Israeli actions in the West Bank.
Britain says the aim is to slow settlement growth and protect the possibility of a two-state solution.
